poses.name: Original grip, sticks at the grip's angle
poses.desc: The first MuJoCo grip (closed_v5_mj3 family, open/close pair from Makis' motion): palm facing the table, the sticks at the angle the grip lab made them. First pick task: a 30 mm cube. Stages 1-2 are shared with pose 2.

stages.name: Hold under disturbances
stages.what: The grip holds both sticks while the palm is pushed, wobbled and shaken.

stages.name: Open and close
stages.what: The sticks open and close on command and come back to the grip each time.

stages.name: Pick and drop
stages.what: Come down, pinch a 25 mm cube, lift it, carry it 10 cm, lower it and let go.

poses.name: Original grip, sticks 15° down
poses.desc: Same grip and same stages 1-2 as pose 1, but the hand tilts so the sticks point 15° below horizontal when picking. Trained on a 30 mm cube, a harder version, then the 25 mm cube.

poses.name: Human-style grip, back of the hand up
poses.desc: Grip hg_1: thumb pad, index and middle on the upper stick; thumb base, index base and ring finger on the lower. The hand is turned over (back up), sticks 20° down, so the tips open and close up and down.

poses.desc: Grip hg_1 (re-settled as hg_1s125), back of the hand up, sticks 20° down, hand turned so the tips open and close sideways. Stiffer hand-stick contacts so the sticks don't creep when the hand shakes.
